defer: After removing every item, the next `todo add` reuses id 1 (`add alpha; remove 1; add beta` -> `added 1`), because pre-existing allocation is max(ids)+1 with fallback 1 on an empty list. The card's Q2 default and C6 only pin the partial-removal case ({1,2} minus 1 -> `added 3`); whether ids may ever be reused after a full clear is unspecified by the request. Not a defect of this unit (behaviour is inherited from store.add, untouched), noted so the request owner can rule on it if id stability matters.

examples/demo has no dedicated README/usage doc of its own (only inline comments in cli.js and the SEP tool's top-level README, which is unrelated to this app). A user exploring examples/demo for docs on the new `remove` command would only find it via `--help`-style usage text or the source, not a written doc. Not covered by any acceptance criterion and the demo never had a README before this change either, so this is not a regression, just a pre-existing gap a customer might still grumble about.
